discovery: Discovery of the fractional quantum anomalous Hall effect (fractional Chern insulators at zero magnetic field) in moire materials

nominees.name: Long Ju
nominees.affiliation: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, USA

subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological phases and fractionalization in moire materials
motivation: For four decades fractionally charged anyons were thought to require strong magnetic fields and Landau levels. In 2023-2024, Xiaodong Xu's group (with optical and transport evidence in twisted MoTe2), Kin Fai Mak's group (with Jie Shan, establishing the topological and correlated phases of moire TMDs, and confirming fractional Chern insulators by thermodynamic measurements), and Long Ju's group (quantized fractional Hall plateaus in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene on hBN) showed that electrons in flat Chern bands spontaneously break time-reversal symmetry and form fractional quantum Hall states at zero field. This realizes the long-sought fractional Chern insulator, turns band topology and quantum geometry into design parameters, and opens an entirely new materials platform for anyons, including candidate non-Abelian states and interfaces with superconductors for topological quantum computation. Theory anticipated the idea; these experiments made it real and changed how the community thinks about topological order.
